correctness.rationale: PASS. Defined the modal Boolean algebra P(omega) with existential reflexive <= diamond. For infinitely many adjacent membership switches both X and its complement are unbounded, so diamonds equal omega and the four Boolean sets are a closed generated algebra (even noncomputable X). For finitely many switches, the s+1 nonempty constant runs generate a closed run-union algebra. The opposite-color bounded set to the terminal run yields prefix P_s under diamond; downward intersections with the opposite color recover all earlier prefixes and individual runs. Hence exact size 2^(s+1), including s=0, and every 2^m realized. Independently computed actual modal closures for 254 eventually constant generators as corroboration.
